apps.name: Qcheck
apps.description: Enterprise-grade quality assurance and system inspection tool designed for rapid diagnostic checks, compliance verification, and batch data validation.

latest_release.name: Qcheck v1.0.0 Initial Release
latest_release.changelog:
### Features
- Complete quality diagnostic inspection engine.
- Automated rule-based compliance checking.
- Direct report export to XLSX and PDF formats.
- Integrated error log viewer with timestamp tagging.

### System Notes
- Verified on Windows 10 & 11 x64.
- Unsigned executable: on first launch, click **More info** then **Run anyway**.

apps.name: Pcount
apps.description: High-throughput count tracking and verification utility. Accurately totals items, monitors production batches, and syncs log data for team reconciliation.

latest_release.name: Pcount v1.0.0 Production Release
latest_release.changelog:
### Features
- Batch counting engine with custom tally thresholds.
- Real-time rate calculation (units/min, units/hr).
- Daily session persistence and CSV log export.
- Lightweight background service mode.
